content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-196. - I.R.C. Section R908.6, Flashing.
content.summary:
Section R908.6. Flashing,
is hereby amended by adding a second paragraph to read as follows:
"R908.6.
Flashing.
Flashing shall be installed in accordance with Section R905."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
